Chooses the unique dummy or actual fine-cell identifier opposing a given actual elementary segment. Assumptions are common origin and finite endpoint data, C ≥ 2, reference k ≥ 50000000, k₀ ≤ k and actual reference fine-cell membership. The dummy neighborhood has one identifier. The lower index k₀ has no separate late bound. The choice is noncomputable.
